verbetes.glosa_atual: (פָּלָא); distinção, peculiaridade, uso da palavra פלא.; especificação distinta e solene de um voto (de Lev. XXVII, 2; Num. VI, 2; v. אִיסְפְּלִיאָה).
definicoes_originais: distinction, peculiarity, use of the word פלא.
distinct and solemn specification of a vow (from Lev. XXVII, 2; Num. VI, 2; v. אִיסְפְּלִיאָה).
notas_originais: Sabb. 138 b ה' זו וכ' this peculiarity of punishment (Deut. XXVIII, 59) &c.; ה' זו תורה it means the Law (afflictions causing the Law to be forgotten, ref. to Is. XXIX, 14).

Tosef. Naz. III, 19 לא ניתנה נזירות אלא לה' the law of the nazir’s vow applies only to distinct utterance (where there is no doubt); Naz. 34 a; a. e.—Ib. 62 a of the two ki yafli (Lev. l. c. Num. l. c.) אחד ה' לאיסור ואחד ה' וכ' one intimates a distinct binding expression, and one a distinctness which opens the way to absolution (v. הֲָטָה); Ḥag. 10 a אחת ה' וכ'.

Y. B. Kam. II, end, 3 a בה' נגיחות it refers to gorings at intervals (not in three consecutive days). Y. Yoma III, 40 b bot. אם להפליג if the conversation lasted long enough to be considered a discontinuation of the services, opp. לשעה. Ib. עשו אותה כה' they declared it (the going out for easing one’s self, v. מסיכה) to be like a discontinuation.
Y. Ab. Zar. III, 42 d bot. תשובת ה' השיבו he made a reply only to divert his mind (Bab. ib. 44 b תשובה גנובה, v. גָּנַב).
Snh. X, 3; a. fr.
, v. הֶפְלֵג

Pes. 15 b ה' חולין an unnecessary destruction of &c.—Ib., a. fr. ה' מרובה a considerable loss, opp. ה' מועט. Ab. II, 1 ה' מצוה the loss (inconvenience, sacrifice) connected with the performance of a good deed. Ib. V, 11, sq. וצא שכרו בהֶפְסֵדוֹ his advantage is set off by his disadvantage. Lev. R. s. 34 הֶפְסֵדָהּ the disadvantage of (punishment for) neglecting it, opp. שכרה reward for observing it. B. Kam. 115 b מפני ה' כהן because it is an injury to the priest (entitled to it). Sabb. 147 b ה' אוכלין a waste of eatables; a. fr.
B. Kam. 115 b דאיכא ה' (ed. הפסדה, corr. acc., Ms. R. a. F. הפסד). v. פְּסֵידָא

Erub. 54 a און לו ה' וכ' there is no end to it for all eternity. Y. Ber. XI, 10 a bot. ה' ברכה an unlawful interruption between the blessing and the partaking of food. Ib. II, 5 b top ימי ה' intervening days during which menstruation ceased. Ib. IX, 13 c bot.; Midr. Till. to Ps. CIV, 32 ה' מלכות interregnum, anarchy. Y. Yeb. II, 3 d bot. שניות אין להן ה' the secondary degrees of forbidden marriages have no limitation; a. fr.

verbetes.glosa_atual: (precedido.) cessação, interrupção, intervalo.; ; um. frag.- Pl. הַפְסָקוֹת.
notas_originais: Gen. R. s. 33 Sivan, the seventh month להַפְסָקַת וכ' counting from the time the rains ceased (Yalk. ib. 59 לירידת). Taan. 4 b לה' with reference to ceasing to insert the mention of rain in the prayers. Lev. R. s. 1, end אין כאן ה' there is nothing intervening (between ויקרא a. וידבר, Lev. I,

Num. R. s. 14, end ה' the intervals in revelations, i.e. passages in the Pentateuch not introduced by vayikra and vaydabber.—Esp. Hafsakah, the Sabbath intervening between the four Sabbaths on which the sections of the Torah, Sh’kalim, Zakhor, Parah and Ha ḥ odesh are severally read, v. פָּרָשָׁה. Meg. 30 a שנייה לה' ‘the second Sabbath’ means that following the Hafsakah.
Ar., v. חַפְצָא
, v. הֶפְקֵרָא

verbetes.glosa_atual: (פָּקַע; cmp. אַפְקַעְתָּא) cancelamento, liberação de dívidas.
definicoes_originais: (פָּקַע; cmp. אַפְקַעְתָּא) cancellation, release from debt.
notas_originais: B. Kam. 113 b הַפְקָעַת הלואתו the cancellation of his (the gentile’s) loan.

verbetes.glosa_atual: (Y. dial. הֶבְקֵר) m. (פָּקַר) declarando liberdade, renúncia à propriedade em favor de quem tomaria posse do objeto renunciado; confisco; propriedade pública.
definicoes_originais: (Y. dial. הֶבְקֵר) m. (פָּקַר) declaring free, renunciation of ownership in favor of whosoever would take possession of the object renounced; confiscation; public property.
notas_originais: Eduy. IV, 3 הפ' לעניים הפ' Ms. M. (ed. הב', v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note) renunciation of ownership (of the standing crop) in favor of the poor is valid (exempting from tithes); (oth. opin.) אינו ה' עד שיפקיר וכ' Ms. M. (ed. שיובקר) it is not valid unless the owner makes it free for the rich, too; Peah IV, 1 (v. Rabb. D. S. a. l.); B. Mets. 30 b הפ'. Yeb. 89 b; Gitt. 36 b ה' ב"ד ה' the confiscation by the court (disposing of private property by the process of law) is valid; Y. Shek. I, 46 a bot. הב'. Peah I, 6 ונותן משום ה' or he may set aside a portion of his crop as public property. Y. ib. III, 17 c bot. וה' חייב בפיאה is public property ever subject to the laws of Peah? Ib. V, 19 b אין הֶבְקֵירוֹ ה' his renunciation is ineffectual. Ib. אין ה' יוצא … אלא בזכייה renounced property does not go out of the owner’s possession, until somebody takes possession of it; Y. Ned. IV, 38 d (corr. acc.). Y. Snh. VI, 23 b, beg. ה' טעות הוא it is a confiscation under an erroneous presumption (and invalid); a. fr.—Gen. R. s. 80, end בני אדם של ה' outlaws. Yeb. 66 a מנהג ה' נהגו בה people took liberties with her (because she had neither the legal status of a freed woman nor that of a slave).

verbetes.glosa_atual: (פקר, cmp. אַפְקָרוּתָא); luxúria desenfreada, ilegalidade.; como precedente. palavra. B. Kam. 115 b מה' קא זכינא (ao garantir o mel de um vaso quebrado na estrada) Tomei posse dos bens renunciados.
definicoes_originais: as preced. word. B. Kam. 115 b מה' קא זכינא (in securing the honey from a broken vessel on the road) I took possession of renounced goods.
notas_originais: Gitt. 13 a עבדא בה' ניחא ליה a slave prefers the dissolute life with a slave (to regular marriage with a free woman); Keth. 11 a
—Targ. Y. Deut. XXV, 5 הֶפְקֵרָא (הֶפְקְרָא) an unprotected woman

verbetes.glosa_atual: (Inf. Hif. de פָּרַר, פּוּר; fr. Num. XXX, esp. versículo 13) a lei de 'hafer', o direito do marido (ou pai) de declarar nulo o voto de sua esposa (ou filha), invalidação.
definicoes_originais: (Inf. Hif. of פָּרַר, פּוּר; fr. Num. XXX, esp. verse 13) the law of ‘hafer’, the husband’s (or father’s) right of declaring void his wife’s (or daughter’s) vow, invalidation.
notas_originais: Ned. X, 7, a. fr. את שבא לכלל הקם בא לכלל ה' whatever comes under the law of hakem (confirmation), comes under the law of hafer (invalidation), i.e. as you cannot confirm a vow before it has been made, so you cannot invalidate a vow in advance. Ib. 69 a; 79 a על הה' in a case where the right of invalidation might have been exercised. Tosef. ib. VII, 5 חומר בהקם שאינו בה' there are restrictions in the law of confirmation which do not apply to the law of invalidation &c. Y. ib. X, 42 a bot. ה' נדרים מעת לעת, v. next w.; a. fr. [In comment. our w. is spelled הפר and הֵיפֵר indiscriminately, which would intimate that it is pronounced הֵפֵר, fr. Num. XXX, 9.]

verbetes.glosa_atual: (precedido.) invalidação, declaração de nulidade; também absolvição por justa causa (v. הַתָּרָה).
definicoes_originais: (preced.) invalidation, declaring void; also absolution for cause (v. הַתָּרָה).
notas_originais: Ned. X, 8 הֲפָרַת נדרים כל היום the right (of the father or the husband) to declare a vow void lasts the whole day on which it came to his notice (to sunset); Y. ib. 42 a bot. הפר נדרים מעת לעת twenty four hours; Tosef. ib. VI, 1; Sabb. 157 a.—Ned. 87 b מה הקמה ממנו אף ה' ממנו as the confirmation may be partial, so may the invalidation &c.; a. fr.—Gitt. 36 a אין לו ה' cannot be absolved from. Shebu. 29 b top כי היכי … ה' in order to make absolution impossible.

verbetes.glosa_atual: (não הַפַּ') m. (ὕπαρχος); governador, tenente.; sujeito (terra), colônia.
notas_originais: — Pl. הִפַּרְכִין, הִפַּרְכֵי, הִי'. Targ. Esth. III, 12.—Ab. Zar. 8 b
Targ. Esth. X, 1 הִפַּרְכֵי ימא (h. text אִיֵי הים); Targ. Y. Gen. XLIX, 13.

Ex. R. s. 18, beg. Yalk. Ps. 875 (to Ps. CXVI, 15) [read:] משל למלך ששלח ה' (v. Midr. Till. to Ps. l. c.); a. e. [Ib. ה' אחרת, read הפרכיא (v. next w.).—Midr. Till. to Ps. XVII בהפרכוס, some ed. בא ה', v. אַפּוֹפְסִין.]— Pl. הִפַּרְכִין, הִי'. Tosef. Gitt. VIII (VI), 3 לשום היפרכון (corr. acc.). V. אִיפַּרְכוֹס.

Sifré Deut. 330; Yalk. ib. 946 [read:] היפטיקוס נכנס לתוך ה' שלו אם יכול ליפרע מכל הוא נפרע ואם לאו וכ' a consul enters his province; if he is able to collect (taxes) from all &c. Yalk. Ps. 875 הפרכוס אחרת (corr. acc.; v. preced.)— Pl. הִפַּרְכִיּוֹת, הִי'. Tosef. Gitt. VIII (VI), 3 ed. Zuck. (v. הורכיינוס).
, v. הַרְפַּנְיָא
Sabb. 155 b ומה ה' בין וכ' and what is the difference between the two? Pes. 27 b אמר להן ה' said he to them, There is a difference; a. fr.
, v. אַפְרָשָׁה
Zeb. V, 4 טעונה ה' ונתוח requires flaying and carving (Lev. I, 6). Ib. 50 b carving שלא בה' without previous flaying. Y. Pes. VI, 33 a bot. הֶפְשֵׁיטוֹ the flaying of it; a. fr.

notas_originais: f. same. Sabb. 116 b קודם הַפְשָׁטַת העור before the hide (up to the chest) is stripped off. Sifra Vayikra, N’dabah, Par. 4, ch. VI (ref. to Lev. I, 6) נתחים שהיו בכלל ה' such pieces as are affected by the order of flaying (to the exclusion of the head which is cut off before flaying); a. e.

Sabb. 40 b הֶפְשֵׁרוֹ זהו בשולו warming is to oil what cooking is to other liquids (a forbidden labor).

definicoes_originais: (פתק to cut, divide off; Var. lect.
notas_originais: v. infra) the store-room in the dwelling house out of which the daily portions of provision and work are distributed; also the retailer’s shelves &c., contrad. to אוצר ware-house. Ab. Zar. II, 7 (39 b) הבאין מן הה' the preserved locusts which the merchant takes from the shelves, contrad. to מן הסלולה, those laid out in baskets in front of the counter. Ib. 40 b מן הה' מן האוצר ומן הספינה (not הסלולה, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 5); Tosef. ib. IV (V), 12 מן הפתק וכ' ed. Zuck. (Var. הפתיק, cmp. הֶמְסֵס for fusion of article) from the shelves, the ware-room or the ship.—Sabb. 50 a; Tosef. ib. III (IV), 19 גיזי צמר של ה' cut wool stored in the pantry (intended for spinning; Rashi: from the merchant’s shelves). [Ar. s. v. אפתק reads: אוּפְתֵּק, noting a Var. ה'. One Ms. Ar., a. Mish. ed. Nap. read אפותיק for אוּפְתֵּיק, induced by phonetic resemblance to ἀποθήκη. V. Ar. ed. Koh. s. v. אפתק, a. Rabb. D. S. to Ab. Zar. 39 b note 8.]
Targ. Y. Gen. XLVII, 14. Ib. Deut. XXIII, 22 (constr.) בהַפְתֵּיק וכ' in the treasury of the Lord (v. Ḥull. 139 a quot. s. v. גִּזָּא).
, read: הִפּוֹתִּיקָאוֹת; הפתקי, read: הִפּוֹתִּיקִי.
, v. הַצָּתָה

verbetes.glosa_atual: (יצב) em pé, uso do verbo יצב.
definicoes_originais: (יצב) standing, use of the verb יצב.
notas_originais: Num. R. s. 18, beg.; Tanḥ. Koraḥ 3 (analogy betw. Num. XVI, 27 a. I Sam. XVII, 4, a. 16). Pesik. Zutr. Nitsab. beg. יש ה' לטובה וכ' the word יצב is sometimes used in a good sense (as firmness) and at times in a bad sense (as provocation); v. יְצִיבָה.
, v. הצֶּלְפּוֹנִי

Meg. 16 b הצָּלַת נפשות saving of human lives. Gitt. 56 a (in Chald. diction) אפשר דהוי ה' פורתא may be some little relief (by royal favor) can be had; ib. b וה' פורתא נמי וכ' and even a little favor will not be shown. Ḥull. 52 b הצלת עצמה the animal’s own effort to save itself; ה' אחרים the human efforts to save the animal. Ex. R. s. 1 ה' מים saving from drowning; a. fr.

definicoes_originais: (b. h.) pr. n. f. Hazzelelponi, alleged name of Samson’s mother.
notas_originais: Num. R. s. 10; B. Bath. 91 a צְלֶלְפּוֹנִית ed. (Ms. R. הצללפונית, Ms. R. צלולפונית).

definicoes_originais: (cmp. preced.), בני ה' prob. name fo a family settled in Babylonia.
notas_originais: M. Kat. 22 a (Ms. M. הצלבוני).
Pesik. Sos, p. 146 b; Yalk. Job 906; (Yalk. Gen. 93 הַצְנֵיעוּת).

verbetes.glosa_atual: (יָצַע) fazer um sofá, arrumar colchões, tapetes etc. Keth. 4b, a. e. הַצָּעַת המטה arrumando a cama (para o marido).
definicoes_originais: (יָצַע) making a couch, laying out of mattresses, carpets &c. Keth. 4 b, a. e. הַצָּעַת המטה making the bed (for her husband).
notas_originais: Yoma 69 a בה' שרי for spreading under (to sit or lie on), garments of mixed materials (כלאים) are permitted.—V. מַצָּע.—Trnsf. arrangement, structure, construction. Ḥull. 49 b כך היא ה' של משנה וכ' the construction of the Mishnah (Boraitha) is as you stated, but reverse the first clause. Snh. 51 a; a. e.
Y. Sabb. II, beg. 4 c צריכה הצאתה ברוב וכ' (corr. acc.) must be kindled so that the larger portion be on fire, v. דֶּלֶק. Y. Yoma II, 39 c top; Bab. ib. 24 b הַצָּתַת וכ' kindling of &c.
Shebu. 35 b; Sabb. 127 (Ms. M. קַבָּלַת) ה' פני שכינה receiving the Divine Presence.

verbetes.glosa_atual: (קדש); aquilo que é dedicado a um propósito sagrado, esp. propriedade sagrada ou do Templo.; dedicação.
definicoes_originais: that which is dedicated to a sacred purpose, esp. sacred or Temple property.
notas_originais: Yeb. 66 b bot., a. fr. ה' וכ' a pledged animal which the debtor dedicates as a sacrifice &c., v. פָּקַע. Gen. R. s. 60 ה' דמים; Arakh. VIII, 7 ה' עילוי dedication of the value of an object; opp. ה' מזבח dedication for the altar (allowing no redemption). Ib. VII, 1 אין מחשבין חדשים לה' months are not counted for redeeming dedicated property, i.e. fractions of a year count for a year in favor of the treasury. Kidd. 2 b דאסר לה אכ"ע כה' because (by betrothing her to himself) he makes her forbidden to all other men like sacred property (v. קָדַשׁ). Taan. 24 a הרי הן ה' עליך וכ' they shall be to thee sacred property (like charity funds); a. v. fr.

Arakh. 2 a; Tem. 2 a תחלת ה' a preliminary act of dedication, סוף ה' the final dedication (laying hands on the animal’s head prior to sacrificing it). Ib. 9 b; B. Mets. 54 b ה' ראשון the original dedication, ה' שני the substitution (for an animal which became defective); a. fr.— Pl. הֶקְדֵּישׁוֹת, הֶקְדֵּשׁ' 1) sacred objects. Lev. R. s. 5; a. fr.—2) laws concerning dedication. Tosef. Erub. XI (VIII), 24; ib. Ḥag. I, 9 (ed. Zuck. והקרקעות, corr. acc.); a. e.

Ker. V, 1 דם ה' שהנפש יוצאה בו the blood of arteries with which life goes out, i.e. the splashing blood; ib. 22 a. Nidd. 19 b.—Gitt. 70 a הַקָּזַת דם blood-letting. Sabb. 29 a סעודת ה' Ms. M. (ed. ה' דם) the meal taken after blood-letting; a. fr.

verbetes.glosa_atual: (קטר) deixando subir fumaça, queimando no altar.
definicoes_originais: (קטר) letting rise in smoke, burning on the altar.
notas_originais: Ber. I, 1; a. fr.
Y. Pes. VII, 34 c top. Y. Yoma II, 39 c; a. e.— Pl. הַקְטָרוֹת. Tosef. Dem. II, 7 הה'; Men. 18 b Ms. M. (ed. הק'); Ḥull. 132 b הק' (v. הֶמְסֵס as to fusion of article).
, v. הֶיקֵּ'
, v. הֶיקֵּ'

verbetes.glosa_atual: (Inf. Hif. de קוּם, formado por analogia com הָפֵר q. v.) confirmação, o privilégio de confirmar um voto.
definicoes_originais: (Inf. Hif. of קוּם, formed for analogy with הָפֵר q. v.) confirmation, the privilege of confirming a vow.
notas_originais: Ned. X, 7; a. fr. (comment. write indiscriminately הקם a. הֵיקֵם, analogous to הֵיפֵר).

verbetes.glosa_atual: (קום) 1) mesmo.; mesmo. Ned. 69 a ה' ראשונה a primeira confirmação (quando ele disse a primeira קיים ליכי).; ereção.
definicoes_originais: same. Ned. 69 a ה' ראשונה the first confirmation (when he said the first קיים ליכי).
notas_originais: Ib. ולא תיחול ה' but my confirmation shall not take effect; a. e.

R. Hash. 2 b להֲקָמַת המשכן dating from the erection of the Tabernacle. Y. Yoma I, 38 c top; Num. R. s. 12, a. e. ה' הלילה the putting up (of the Tabernacle) by night; a. e.— Pl. הֲקָמוֹת. Ib. הֲקָמוֹתָיו his repeated acts of putting up.
f., v. אַקְנָיָיתָא
, v. הֶיקֵּ'
, v. אַקְפָּדָה

verbetes.glosa_atual: (נָקַף II); cercando, dando voltas.; (ref. ao Lev. XIX, 27) rapar os cabelos da cabeça em toda a volta.; crescimento de cabelo ao redor de um membro.
definicoes_originais: (ref. to Lev. XIX, 27) shaving the hair of the head all around.
growth of hair around a limb.
debts for merchandise payable at certain seasons (cmp. תְּקוּפָה).
notas_originais: Yoma 59 a ה' ברגל the sprinkling was done in walking around; ה' ביד by circular movements of the hand. Pesik. R. s. 41 הַקָּפַת המזבח going around the altar in procession with the Lulab; a. e.

Naz. 29 a ועביד ה' and he (the Nazir) may shave &c. Ib. הַקָּפַת כל הראש shaving the entire head, opp. to ה' פאה shaving the ends, v. פֵּאָה. Y. Sot. II, beg. 17 d ה' נזירות the shaving required by Nazir laws (Num. VI, 18); a. e.
Y. Yeb. X, end, 11 c; Snh. 68 b

Shebi. X, 1; Tosef. ib. VIII, 3 הקפת חנות וכ' shop-debts are not subject to the law of limitation in the Sabbatical year.— Pl. הַקָּפוֹת. Gen. R. s. 41 he came back לפרוע הַקָּפוֹתָיו to pay his debts; Yalk. ib. 69.
Midr. Till. to Ps. XVII, 15 הֲקָצַת המתים resurrection of the dead.

verbetes.glosa_atual: (קוּץ, קָצַץ) cortar, הֲקָצַת שפתים (cmp. Prov. XVI, 30) cortar os lábios, ou seja, contrair a boca para uma expressão blasfema.
definicoes_originais: (קוּץ, קָצַץ) cutting, הֲקָצַת שפתים (cmp. Prov. XVI, 30) cutting the lips, i.e. contracting the mouth for a blasphemous expression.
notas_originais: Snh. 65 a Ar. a. Ms. K. (ed. עקימת, v. עֲקִימָה).

verbetes.glosa_atual: (Inf. Hif. de קוּר; cmp. Jer. VI, 7) jorrando, derramando (cmp. מָקוֹר).
definicoes_originais: (Inf. Hif. of קוּר; cmp. Jer. VI, 7) welling, pouring forth (cmp. מָקוֹר).
notas_originais: (בּוֹר) בְּאֵר ה' well, opp. to cistern; esp. B’er Haker name of a certain well. Erub. X, 14. Ib. 104 b כל הבורות ה' Ms. M. (ed. incorr. הקרות); Y. ib. II, beg. 20 a

verbetes.glosa_atual: (קָרַב); oferta, uso do verbo הִקְרִיב.; aproximando-se para o ataque.
definicoes_originais: offering, use of the verb הִקְרִיב.
notas_originais: Men. 11 a בת ה' היא it is an object which may eventually be offered. B. Kam. 12 b חזי לה' fit for offering (if the Temple existed). Erub. 63 b, a. e. גדול … מהקְרָבַת תמידין study of the Law is more important than the offering of daily sacrifices. Lev. R. s. 2, end נאמר ה' וכ' the term הקריב is used &c. Ib. s. 20 they died על הקריבה ועל ה' (= הַהַ') for coming near (Lev. XVII,
Ex. R. s. 21 הקרבת פרעה (Ex. XIV, 10).
Sifra Num. 159; Yalk. ib. 787 (interpret. הקריתם, Num. XXXV, 11).
, v. הֶיקֵּ'
Snh. 65 a הַקָּשַׁת זרועותיו the clapping of his (the necromancer’s) arms; Ker. 3 b.— Pl. הַקָּשֹׁות. Ib. (Snh. l. c. always sing.).

Midd. II, 1, a. fr. הַר הבית the Temple mount. Yeb. 17 a (play on ה̇ר̇פ̇נ̇יא) ה̇ר̇ שהכל פ̇ונ̇ין בו a hill to which all turn (whose spurious descent prevents them from getting wives elsewhere); a. v. fr.—Ḥull. 39 b (in Chald. diction) רישיך והר here is thy head and here the mountain (a colloquial phrase for compelling one to give up a bargain).—Ex. R. s. 28 (ref. to Ex. XIX, 3) בזכות הה' for the merit of the distinguished one (Abraham), ואין הה' אלא אבות har means the patriarchs (ref. to Mic. VI, 2). Snh. 107 a ה' שבכם the most prominent of you; a. fr.—[For proper nouns composed with הר, v. respective determinants.]— Pl. הָרִים, הֲרָרִים. Tam. 32 a, a. e. הָרֵי חושך, v. חו̇שֶׁךְ.—Snh. 24 a עוקר הרי הרים uprooting the highest mountains (a figure for dialectical ingenuity). Y. Yeb. I, 3 a bot. בין שני הֶהָ' וכ' between the two high mountains (great scholars). Ex. R. s. 15 ואין ה' אלא אבות, v. supra.—Ḥag. I, 8 כה' תלויין בשערה like mountains suspended on a hair (a slender Bible text for numerous Talmudic laws); a. v. fr.
אַהֲרֵי (cmp. חרי, חרר) to heat, irritate. Targ. Prov. XXV, 20 מַהֲרָא (Var. מַהְרָה) ed. Lag. (ed. מחרא, ed. Wil. מחדא, corr. acc.); v. בּרְיוּתָא.—Cmp. הִרְהֵר, חִרְחֵר.

verbetes.glosa_atual: (Inf. Hif. de רָבָה) aumentar; o valor numérico das letras ה̇ר̇ב̇ה̇ = 212 (dias).
definicoes_originais: (Inf. Hif. of רָבָה) to increase; the numerical value of the letters ה̇ר̇ב̇ה̇ = 212 (days).
notas_originais: Gen. R. s. 20 (play on הרבה ארבה, Gen. III, 16) כל שהוא ה' ארבה וכ' if an embryo is 212 days old, I shall cause it to grow (it is vital); Y. Nidd. I, 49 b top כל שהוא בה' הרי הוא בארבה; v. אל"ף.

definicoes_originais: (רָבַע) the ( forbidden) coupling of heterogeneous animals.
notas_originais: Snh. 56 b הַרְבָּעַת בהמה; Sifra Aḥaré Par. 9, ch. XIII. Ḥull. 71 a לה' with reference to forbidden coupling; a. e.

verbetes.glosa_atual: (b. h.) [ cortar, v. הֶרֶג,] matar, condenar à morte.; ser morto, executado.
definicoes_originais: (b. h.) [ to cut, v. הֶרֶג,] to kill, put to death.
notas_originais: Num. R. s. 21, beg. בא לַהֲרָגְךָ השכם להָרְגֹּו if one comes to kill thee, be the first to kill him; Ber. 58 a; Snh. 72 a להֹורְגְּךָ … להֹורְגֹו. Gitt. 56 b כסבור ה' את עצמו he (Titus) thought he had killed himself (euphem. for the Lord); a. v. fr.— Part. pass. הָרוּג. Tosef. Gitt. V (III), 1 הֲרוּגִין שנהרגו לפני מלחמה ובשעת מלחמה (ed. Zuck. בשעת) those executed (by the Roman government) before and during the Vespasian war; Y. Gitt. V, 47 b top [read:] הֲרוּגֵי המלחמה ולפני וכ'. Y. Ber. I, 3 d, v. בִּיתֵּר. Pes. 50 a; B. Bath. 10 b, a. e. הרוגי מלכות martyrs under the Roman government (R. Akiba and his fellow-martyrs), v. לוּד; a. fr.
Taan. 18 b נֶהֶרְגוּ were put to death (by the Roman government). Gitt. 56 a יֵהָרֵג is to be put to death. Snh. 74 a עבור ואל תֵּהָרֵג transgress or thou wilt be killed; a. fr.

verbetes.glosa_atual: (precedido.) assassino, salteador, contrad. para חרם o opressor que não ameaça matar.
definicoes_originais: (preced.) murderer, highway-man, contrad. to חרם the oppressor who does not threaten to kill.
notas_originais: Y. B. Mets. IV, end, 9 d.— Pl. הָרָגִין. Ned. III, 4, v. נָדַר.

verbetes.glosa_atual: precedeu. wds.) execução por decapitação com espada.
definicoes_originais: preced. wds.) execution by decapitation with a sword.
notas_originais: Snh. VII, 1; a. fr.

verbetes.glosa_atual: (prob. = אַרְגָּז q. v.) eufemismo. para nádegas (ou testículos).
definicoes_originais: (prob. = אַרְגָּז q. v.) euphem. for buttocks (or testicles).
notas_originais: Bekh. VI, 6 הַרְגִּיזֹו Maim., Ar. Var. הַרְגֹּוזֹו, ed. אָכוּז q. v.

verbetes.glosa_atual: (רגל, v. רָגִיל); hábito; ה' לשון hábito da língua, fluência adquirida pela memorização.; levando a, ocasião para.
definicoes_originais: habit; ה' לשון habit of the tongue, fluency acquired by memorizing.
notas_originais: habit of the tongue, fluency acquired by memorizing. Koh. R. to VI, 9.
מפני ה' עבירה because it offers an occasion for sin. Sabb. I, 3; Pes. 30 a; 36 a; a. e.—Ab. Zar. 17 a ה' דבר (euphem.) preliminaries of sexual connection.
, v. חַרְנֹוגָא
, v. חַרְגִּינִּין

Nidd. 43 a נעקרה בה' he felt the effusion coming, ויצתה שלא בה' but the discharge was not perceived. Ib. 57 b הַרְגָּשַׁת מי וכ' the sensation of discharging urin; a. fr. Yalk. Jud. 42 לכל ה' וה' to every sense.— Pl. הַרְגָּשֹׁות senses. Num. R. s. 14 כנגד חמש ה' וחמש מורגשות corresponding to the five senses and the five perceptions.
, v. חַרְגָּא
, v. הִרְדַּוְלִיס
Targ. Ps. CL, 4 Ms. (Regia הרדיב', ed. חֲלִילִין).

verbetes.glosa_atual: m. mesmo. Arakh. 10b (não…לים); Tosef. eu. Eu, 13 הרדאולים לא היו וכ' ed. Zuck. (corr. acc.; ed. הִדְרַאוְלִי' לא היה); cmp. אִדְרַבְלִיס.
notas_originais: m. same. Arakh. 10 b (not … לים); Tosef. ib. I, 13 הרדאולים לא היו וכ' ed. Zuck. (corr. acc.; ed. הִדְרַאוְלִי' לא היה); cmp. אִדְרַבְלִיס.

verbetes.glosa_atual: (transpos. de דרס, v. מִדְּרָא, מִדְּרֹון &c.) a cópula de pássaros; מעשה ה' gratificação não natural no corpo de uma mulher.
definicoes_originais: (transpos. of דרס, v. מִדְּרָא, מִדְּרֹון &c.) the copulation of birds; מעשה ה' unnatural gratification on a woman’s body.
notas_originais: Snh. 66 b Ar. (ed. חידודין; v. הֲרוּרִים). [Ar.: doing of Herod, ref. to B. Bath. 3 b; v. הֹורְדֹּוס.]
, v. הִירְדּוּף
, v. הַרדָּפָה
, v. הַרְדַּפְנֵי

verbetes.glosa_atual: (comp. de הר = חר, a. דֹּופָן; v. חַרְחֲבִינָה) hera, cujas folhas podem ser usadas como ervas amargas na noite de Páscoa.
definicoes_originais: (comp. of הר = חר, a. דֹּופָן; v. חַרְחֲבִינָה) wall-ivy, the leaves of which may be used for bitter herbs on the Passover night.
notas_originais: Pes. 39 a (Ms. M. הַרְרְּפַ'). V. הַרְרַּפְנֵי.

verbetes.glosa_atual: , יוני ה' uma espécie de pomba domesticada (provavelmente assim chamada pela maneira de sua frutificação, v. הִרְדּוּס).
definicoes_originais: , יוני ה' a species of domesticated doves (prob. so named from the manner of their fructification, v. הִרְדּוּס).
notas_originais: Ḥull. XII, 1; Bets. 25 a; Tosef. ib. I, 10; Tosef. Ḥull. X, 9 הרד' ed. Zuck. (Var. הדר'). Ḥull. 139 b חד תני הדר' וחד תני הרד' וכ' one reads hadr., and one reads hard., the one deriving our w. from Herod, the other from the name of a place.

verbetes.glosa_atual: (הדף, com ר ​​inserido; cmp. הִירְדּוּף [remoção, isolamento,] prisão dentro de um recinto estreito de juncos ou postes, uma punição por desacato ao tribunal (v. נִידּוּי).
definicoes_originais: (הדף, with ר inserted; cmp. הִירְדּוּף [ removal, isolation,] imprisonment within a narrow enclosure of reeds or poles, a punishment for contempt of court (v. נִידּוּי).
notas_originais: M. Kat. 16 a (explain. לִשְׁרֹושִׁי, Ezra VII, 26). Ib. (a version of the Gaonim quoted by Asheri a. l., Nr. 53) מאי ה' א"ר פפא נצבי דקני what is hardafah? Said R. P., Poles of reeds (fastened in the ground). [In ed. a. Mss. the answer to מאי ה' is absent.] [Ar. ed. Koh. הִרְדֹּופָה.]
, v. next w.

verbetes.glosa_atual: (Chald. forma de הַרְיֹּופַנִּין) uma trepadeira cujas bagas eram conhecidas por serem prejudiciais aos animais.
definicoes_originais: (Chald. form of הַרְיֹּופַנִּין) a creeper the berries of which were known to be injurious to animals.
notas_originais: Ḥull. III, 5 (58 b); Tosef. ib. III, 19.—Mekh. B’shall., Vayassa 1 (ref. to Ex. XV, 25) זה עץ ה' it was the trunk of an ivy; Ex. R. s. 50; (ib. s. 23 ירדינון); Yalk. ib. 256 הרדפוני (corr. acc.); Tanḥ. B’shall. 24 ה' מר היה; Tanḥ., ed. Bub., ib. 19.—[Var. הירדופני, v. Koh. Ar. s. v.]—Targ. Y. Ex. XV, 25 אַרְדַּפְנֵי.
, v. הַרְדֹּופַ'

verbetes.glosa_atual: (bh) conceber, estar grávida.; ser concebido; *(homilete.) concepção, v.
definicoes_originais: (b. h.) to conceive, be with child.
to be conceived ; *(homilet.) conception, v. הֹורָת.
notas_originais: Yalk. Ex. 168, end. Y. B. Kam. V, 5 a top; Bab. ib. 49 a
Gen. R. s. 64; Yalk. Job 894 that she would have said to him, ה' גבר is this a time for conception, man? (‘Rashi’).
v. הִירְ'

verbetes.glosa_atual: esterco encharcado de urina, v. דָּהוֹן a. דְּהֵין.
definicoes_originais: urin-soaked dung, v. דָּהוֹן a. דְּהֵין.

verbetes.glosa_atual: (הִרְהֵר); pensamento, meditação, opp. דיבור recitação alta.; imaginação aquecida, esp. fantasias impuras.
definicoes_originais: thought, meditation, opp. דיבור loud recitation.
notas_originais: Ber. 20 b ה' כדיבור דמי reviewing in mind (a Biblical passage &c.) is as good as loud recitation. Sabb. 150 a (ref. to Is. LVIII, 13) דיבור אסור ה' וכ' talking (business on the Sabbath) is forbidden, thinking (planning) is permitted.

Ber. 12 b ה' עבירה unchaste imagination, ה' ע"ז idolatrous fancy. Nidd. 13 b המביא עצמו לידי ה' who allows sinful fancies to take a hold of him. Zab. II, 2; a. fr.— Pl. הִרְהוּרִים. Yoma 29 a top הִרְהוּרֵי עבירה וכ' sinful (obscene) imaginations are more injurious to health than the sin itself. Esth. R. to III, 1 (play on aḥar) הרהורי דברים היו שם plans (schemes) were there.

verbetes.glosa_atual: Targ. Ó. Deut. XXIX, 18. Targ. E.ib. XXIII, 11; um. e.-Snh. 45 a חיישי לה' leva em consideração a possibilidade de criar pensamentos impuros (entre os espectadores); Sot. 8 a.— Pl. הַרְהֹורִין, הִרְהוּרִין, הִירְ'. Targ. Y.Lev.
notas_originais: Targ. O. Deut. XXIX, 18. Targ. Y. ib. XXIII, 11; a. e.—Snh. 45 a חיישי לה' take into consideration the possibility of creating impure thoughts (among the spectators); Sot. 8 a.— Pl. הַרְהֹורִין, הִרְהוּרִין, הִירְ'. Targ. Y. Lev. VI, 2. Targ. Ez. XXXVIII, 10; a. fr.

verbetes.glosa_atual: (Pilp. de הרר; v. הָרָה, cmp. esp. Is. LIX, 13); conceber em mente, pensar, meditar, planejar.; ser aquecido, entreter pensamentos impuros.; (seguido por אחר) para menosprezar, criticar, depreciar.
definicoes_originais: (Pilp. of הרר; v. הָרָה, cmp. esp. Is. LIX, 13)
to conceive in mind, to think, meditate, plan.
to be heated, entertain impure thoughts.
(followed by אחר) to disparage, criticise, detract from.
to heat, make sick with fever.
notas_originais: Ber. III, 4 מְהַרְהֵר בלבו thinks (recites the Sh’ma) in his heart, v. הִרְהוּר. Gitt. 57 b הי' תשובה בדעתיה he conceived the idea of repentance.
Ḥull. 37 b לא הִרְהַרְתִּי ביום I allowed no impure thoughts to rise in me in day-time; a. fr.

Snh. 110 a המְהַרְהֵר אחר רבו who speaks evil of his teacher. Num. R. s. 7 אם הִרְהַרְתָּ וכ' if thou criticisest them &c. Ber. 19 a אל תְּהַרְהֵר אחריו ביום do not think evil of him the day after (for he surely repented). Sifré Deut. 307 אין להַרְהֵר אחר מדותיו you must not criticise His dealings with man; a. fr.
Lev. R. s. 17 (play on ח̇ר̇צבות, Ps. LXXIII, 4; v. ה"א) לא הִרְהַרְתִּים בחלאים (Var. חרחר'; Ar. s. v. חרצב: ערער') I did not make them hot with diseases; Yalk. Ps. 808. [Ukts. III, 11, v. חרְחֵר.]

verbetes.glosa_atual: Targ. Y. Gen. VI, 2.—Targ. Jó II, 10 הַירְהֵר; um. frag.
notas_originais: Targ. Y. Gen. VI, 2.—Targ. Job II, 10 הַירְהֵר; a. fr.
, Y. Kil. I, 27 a, v. נֵיוְיָינָא
M. Kat. 2 a

verbetes.glosa_atual: alívio, liberação.; abundância, provisão liberal; conforto.
notas_originais: Ex. R. s. 10, end; Tanḥ., ed. Bub., Vaëra 22; Yalk. Ex. 186 (cmp. הֶמְסֵס as to fusion of article). Tanḥ. Mikk. 10, v. בָּסַר I; a. e.

Snh. 21 b לא צריכא לה' the word לֹו is to intimate a liberal appropriation (for the army). Sifré Deut. 306 ואין לשון פתיחה אלא לשון ה' the word ‘opening’ has the meaning of comfort, opp. לשון דוחק. Keth. 43 a אלמנתו לא ניחא ליה בה' וכ' as to his widow he cares not for her living comfortably (from her own earnings besides the legal alimentation) &c.
, Tosef. Toh. VIII, 1, v. חֲדוּיִין

verbetes.glosa_atual: (הרר, v. הִרְהֵר) aquecimento, מעשה ה' gratificação não natural no corpo de uma mulher.
definicoes_originais: (הרר, v. הִרְהֵר) heating, מעשה ה' unnatural gratification on a woman’s body.
notas_originais: Snh. 66 b, Resp. Gaon. ed. Cassel, p. 110; v. הִרְדּוּס, a. חִידּוּד.
